invariants.description: the vessels outflow reaches the constant inflow at steady state (v → 1e-4 m^3/s, 0.1%)
the vessel pressure settles at the imposed outlet pressure plus the resistive drop, u → P + R v = P + 1000 Pa (±1 Pa)
vessel volume balance: q(t) − q(0) = ∫(v_in − v) dt with v_in = 1e-4 (trapezoidal, 0.1%)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((va__q - va__q[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(((1e-4) - (va__v))[1:] + ((1e-4) - (va__v))[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) <= 1e-3*max(1e-12, np.max(np.abs(va__q - va__q[0])))

bc_sweep.rationale: Outlet (venous / right-atrial) pressures from 0 to 15 mmHg (0-2000 Pa). v is excluded: it is the flow the connected vessel supplies (a port input), so its parameter value is not used when connected.

baseline.reason: prescribed boundary value (a constant pressure); nothing to validate on its own. Verified against the analytic steady state of a test vessel.
